Class ControlFlowGraph

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.ir.ControlFlowGraph
public final class ControlFlowGraph extends Object
The control-flow graph of one IrMethod, shared by the data-flow passes: every block's successors and predecessors (by block start), a reverse postorder from the entry block, and the dominator tree. Blocks are identified by IrBasicBlock.start(); the entry is the method's first block.
